title: DOE LNG destination-specific FOB export-price comparison evidence

targetSeries.destination: European Union member destinations individually; optionally EU aggregate only when exact composition documented
targetSeries.metric: DOE-reported LNG export FOB weighted average price
targetSeries.unit: USD per thousand cubic feet or USD per MMBtu (normalize with documented conversion)
requirements: Report monthly destination-specific LNG volumes and weighted FOB prices
Identify destination codes and member-country inclusion
State whether DOE tables reflect cargo declarations or estimated prices
Keep same unit and period in all comparisons

targetSeries.destination: China, India, Japan, South Korea individually
targetSeries.metric: DOE-reported LNG export FOB weighted average price
targetSeries.unit: USD per thousand cubic feet or USD per MMBtu
requirements: Use identical DOE definitions as Europe comparison
Flag destinations with zero or suppressed observations
No claim about final resale price or buyer delivered cost

priceSemantics.fob: Free-on-board price at export point, not realized company cash receipts or net profits
priceSemantics.landed: Includes additional transport and regasification; not interchangeable with FOB
priceSemantics.revenue: A hypothetical gross export value may be volume × FOB price only if clearly labeled and matched, never company profit
priceSemantics.netBenefit: Requires realized receipts, margins, infrastructure costs, domestic price effects, taxes and counterfactual

sourceValidation: Download original DOE LNG Monthly report and identify exact table/page for destination FOB prices
Check whether latest report has destination-level FOB prices and volume or only aggregate
Verify consistent revisions, units and calendar-month alignment
Add numeric observations only after exact table-level confirmation
